items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of Warren Evans by the interviewee Sam Jones. The name appears only in a note by the interviewer/speaker regarding a band, with no personal connection established between Sam Jones and Warren Evans.

ctx.x: He had a good band, you see. But the band that I always wanted to hear and never got a chance to hear them
*Possibly either Warren Evans or Jimmy Lewis; Evans recorded more with Johnson during the early 1940s, with Lewis as a backup.
when they came through there in Kansas City, you know. Hooty and them...
